gloss: to watch; to view (TV, video, media)

definitions.gloss: to watch; to view; to watch and listen to (TV, video, media)
definitions.explanation: To watch and listen to broadcast or recorded media such as television programs, videos, or online content. Combines seeing ({視|し}) and hearing ({聴|ちょう}).

examples.japanese: ニュースを{視聴|しちょう}する。
この{動画|どうが}は{一万人|いちまんにん}が{視聴|しちょう}した。
examples.english: Ten thousand people viewed this video.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}はテレビよりもスマホで{動画|どうが}を{視聴|しちょう}する{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, more people are watching videos on their smartphones rather than on TV.

notes:
Specifically used for watching audiovisual media (TV, video, streaming). Not used for watching sports in person or watching someone do something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {視聴|しちょう}{率|りつ} — viewership rating
- {視聴|しちょう}{者|しゃ} — viewer, audience
- {視聴|しちょう}{回数|かいすう} — view count (for online videos)
- {動画|どうが}を{視聴|しちょう}する — to watch a video
- {番組|ばんぐみ}を{視聴|しちょう}する — to watch a program

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見|み}る — the general everyday word for watching/seeing; used in all contexts
- {観|み}る — to watch, view (movies, plays, sports); implies appreciation
- {鑑賞|かんしょう}する — to appreciate, enjoy (art, music, film); more about aesthetic enjoyment
